mapper.select: SELECT ID,PARK_ID,CREATE_TIME,START_TIME,END_TIME,CAUSE,CERT_TYPE,CERT_NO,VISITOR_NAME,VISITOR_PHOTO_ID,IS_VEHICLE,VEHICLE_PLATE,PROCESS_ID,RECEPTIONIST_BADGE,PROMOTER_BADGE,STATUS,DEL_FLAG FROM SMT_VISITOR WHERE PARK_ID=#{park,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ID=#{id,jdbcType=NUMERIC} FOR UPDATE
SELECT ID,VISITOR_ID,CERT_TYPE,CERT_NO,FELLOW_NAME,FELLOW_PHOTO_ID FROM SMT_FELLOW_VISITOR WHERE VISITOR_ID=#{parent,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ID=#{id,jdbcType=NUMERIC} FOR UPDATE
SELECT ID,VISITOR_ID,CERT_TYPE,CERT_NO,FELLOW_NAME,FELLOW_PHOTO_ID FROM SMT_FELLOW_VISITOR WHERE VISITOR_ID=#{parent,jdbcType=NUMERIC} ORDER BY ID FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_SOURCE WHERE BATCH_ID=#{batch,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ORDINAL=#{ordinal,jdbcType=NUMERIC}

SELECT SUM(N) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) N FROM SMT_AUTH_SELECTION_SOURCE S WHERE S.PARK_ID=#{park,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND S.STATE!='CONVERGED' AND S.SOURCE_KIND IN ('VISITOR','VISITOR_FELLOW','VISITOR_VEHICLE') AND ((S.PARENT_KIND='VISITOR' AND S.PARENT_ROW_ID=#{parent,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) OR (S.SOURCE_KIND IN ('VISITOR','VISITOR_VEHICLE') AND S.SUBJECT_ID=#{parent,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) OR (S.SOURCE_KIND='VISITOR_FELLOW' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_FELLOW_VISITOR F WHERE TO_CHAR(F.ID)=S.SUBJECT_ID AND TO_CHAR(F.VISITOR_ID)=#{parent,jdbcType=VARCHAR}))) UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) N FROM SMT_AUTH_SOURCE_COORD C WHERE C.PARK_ID=#{park,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND C.STATE NOT IN ('ACTIVE','TOMBSTONE') AND C.SOURCE_KIND IN ('VISITOR','VISITOR_FELLOW','VISITOR_VEHICLE') AND ((C.SUBJECT_TYPE IN ('VISITOR','VISITOR_VEHICLE') AND C.SUBJECT_ID=#{parent,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) OR (C.SUBJECT_TYPE='VISITOR_FELLOW' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_FELLOW_VISITOR F WHERE TO_CHAR(F.ID)=C.SUBJECT_ID AND TO_CHAR(F.VISITOR_ID)=#{parent,jdbcType=VARCHAR}))) )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_SNAP_VEHICLE E JOIN SMT_DEVICE D ON D.ID=E.DEVICE_ID JOIN SMT_VISITOR V ON V.ID=E.DRIVER_ID AND V.PARK_ID=E.PARK_ID WHERE E.ID=#{event,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND E.DRIVER_ID=#{parent,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND E.PARK_ID=#{park,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND D.PARK_ID=E.PARK_ID AND E.EVENT_TYPE=2 AND E.VEHICLE_ASCRIPTION=2 AND E.DRIVER_TYPE=2 AND E.CARD_NO=TO_CHAR(V.ID) AND E.VEHICLE_PLATE=V.VEHICLE_PLATE AND E.SNAP_TIME>=#{from,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND E.SNAP_TIME<=#{to,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND E.SNAP_TIME<=SYSTIMESTAMP

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMT_SNAP_PERSON E JOIN SMT_DEVICE D ON D.ID=E.DEVICE_ID JOIN SMT_FELLOW_VISITOR F ON F.ID=E.PERSON_ID JOIN SMT_VISITOR V ON V.ID=F.VISITOR_ID WHERE E.ID=#{event,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND F.ID=#{fellow,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND E.PARK_ID=#{park,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND V.PARK_ID=E.PARK_ID AND D.PARK_ID=E.PARK_ID AND E.EVENT_TYPE=2 AND E.PERSON_TYPE=2 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM SMT_VISITOR M WHERE M.ID=E.PERSON_ID) AND E.SNAP_TIME>=#{from,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND E.SNAP_TIME<=#{to,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND E.SNAP_TIME<=SYSTIMESTAMP
